name: learn
description: Root-causes one specific mistake the agent just made, such as not committing despite instructions to, by checking it against the loaded AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skills, and Beads memories, delegating the investigation to a separate agent where the harness supports one; proposes concrete context improvements, and lets the user choose which to apply and how to remediate. Use when the user invokes `/learn` or `$learn`, with or without a description of the mistake, including `/learn /qs`-style shorthand naming the corrective command. Also use unprompted as soon as the agent admits a mistake of its own, or is about to propose changing instructions, skills, or memories because of one, instead of making or recommending that edit directly. For a broad end-of-session documentation sweep, use `documentation-updates` (`/reflect`) instead.
